scenes.tts: Feedback explains how a winner pulls ahead. Does it need help?
scenes.visual: Title card: Winners Push Losers. A strong neuron beside a weak neighbour.
scenes.narration: Feedback explains how a winner pulls ahead. Does it need help?

scenes.tts: What should a punishment signal look like? It should come from strongly supported neurons, and kill weak ones.
scenes.visual: A checklist of four properties; the first two appear.
scenes.narration: What should a punishment signal look like? It should come from strongly supported neurons, and kill weak ones.

scenes.tts: It should spare strong ones. And it should start only after Track A has risen.
scenes.caption: It should spare strong ones. And it should start only after TrkA has risen.
scenes.visual: The last two properties appear on the checklist.
scenes.narration: It should spare strong ones. And it should start only after TrkA has risen.

scenes.tts: The candidates were already on the gene list. Strongly supported neurons make B D N F and N T four.
scenes.caption: The candidates were already on the gene list. Strongly supported neurons make BDNF and NT-4.
scenes.visual: Strong neurons glow and release BDNF and NT-4 dots.
scenes.narration: The candidates were already on the gene list. Strongly supported neurons make BDNF and NT-4.

scenes.tts: Sympathetic neurons carry little of the usual receptor for these, Track B. But they do carry p seventy five.
scenes.caption: Sympathetic neurons carry little of the usual receptor for these, TrkB. But they do carry p75.
scenes.visual: On the weak neighbour: few TrkB receptors, but p75 receptors present (also shown on the strong neuron).
scenes.narration: Sympathetic neurons carry little of the usual receptor for these, TrkB. But they do carry p75.

scenes.tts: p seventy five belongs to the tumour necrosis factor receptor family. In this setting, it can promote death.
scenes.caption: p75 belongs to the tumour necrosis factor receptor family. In this setting, it can promote death.
scenes.visual: Label: p75, TNF receptor family. A death arrow inside the weak cell.
scenes.narration: p75 belongs to the tumour necrosis factor receptor family. In this setting, it can promote death.

scenes.tts: These factors can act on neighbouring neurons, strong ones included. Why are the winners spared?
scenes.visual: On screen: why are the winners spared? Pause and predict.
scenes.narration: These factors can act on neighbouring neurons, strong ones included. Why are the winners spared?

scenes.tts: A neuron with strong N G F and Track A signaling is protected.
scenes.caption: A neuron with strong NGF and TrkA signaling is protected.
scenes.visual: The strong neuron's TrkA signal glows like a shield.
scenes.narration: A neuron with strong NGF and TrkA signaling is protected.

scenes.tts: One likely reason: strong Track A signaling keeps survival pathways high, such as A K T.
scenes.caption: One likely reason: strong TrkA signaling keeps survival pathways high, such as AKT.
scenes.visual: Label inside the strong neuron: one likely reason, survival pathways such as AKT high.
scenes.narration: One likely reason: strong TrkA signaling keeps survival pathways high, such as AKT.

scenes.tts: That outweighs a death signal from p seventy five. A weakly supported neuron has no such cushion.
scenes.caption: That outweighs a death signal from p75. A weakly supported neuron has no such cushion.
scenes.visual: A balance tips toward survival in the strong cell and toward death in the weak one.
scenes.narration: That outweighs a death signal from p75. A weakly supported neuron has no such cushion.

scenes.tts: The lab tested three predictions in the mouse superior cervical ganglion.
scenes.visual: Three numbered boxes appear.
scenes.narration: The lab tested three predictions in the mouse superior cervical ganglion.

scenes.tts: First, competing neurons differ in Track A level. This was tested in ganglia lacking Bax.
scenes.caption: First, competing neurons differ in TrkA level. This was tested in ganglia lacking Bax.
scenes.visual: Box 1: a Bax-null ganglion with neurons stained for TrkA, some bright, some dim.
scenes.narration: First, competing neurons differ in TrkA level. This was tested in ganglia lacking Bax.

scenes.tts: Second, neurons with low Track A show high p seventy five death signaling, read out by phosphorylated see-Jun.
scenes.caption: Second, neurons with low TrkA show high p75 death signaling, read out by phosphorylated c-Jun.
scenes.visual: Box 2: dim-TrkA neurons light up with a c-Jun marker.
scenes.narration: Second, neurons with low TrkA show high p75 death signaling, read out by phosphorylated c-Jun.

scenes.tts: See-Jun is a transcription factor. A stress kinase downstream of p seventy five helps activate it on the way to death.
scenes.caption: c-Jun is a transcription factor. A stress kinase downstream of p75 helps activate it on the way to death.
scenes.visual: Label: c-Jun, helped on by JNK, a stress kinase downstream of p75.
scenes.narration: c-Jun is a transcription factor. A stress kinase downstream of p75 helps activate it on the way to death.

scenes.tts: Third, removing punishment should delay the loss but not prevent it.
scenes.visual: Box 3: a p75-null mouse.
scenes.narration: Third, removing punishment should delay the loss but not prevent it.

scenes.tts: Sketch neuron number against age, in normal mice and in mice lacking p seventy five. What does the second curve do?
scenes.caption: Sketch neuron number against age, in normal mice and in mice lacking p75. What does the second curve do?
scenes.visual: Empty axes: neuron number against age. On screen: sketch the p75-null curve. Pause and predict.
scenes.narration: Sketch neuron number against age, in normal mice and in mice lacking p75. What does the second curve do?

scenes.tts: Both start at similar numbers. The normal curve falls steeply in the first days after birth.
scenes.visual: The wild-type curve is drawn falling steeply after birth.
scenes.narration: Both start at similar numbers. The normal curve falls steeply in the first days after birth.

scenes.tts: The curve without p seventy five falls more slowly. So for a while, it has more neurons.
scenes.caption: The curve without p75 falls more slowly. So for a while, it has more neurons.
scenes.visual: The p75-null curve is drawn falling more slowly, above the wild-type curve at first.
scenes.narration: The curve without p75 falls more slowly. So for a while, it has more neurons.

scenes.tts: The losers still die of too little N G F, through Bax. Only the extra push is gone.
scenes.caption: The losers still die of too little NGF, through Bax. Only the extra push is gone.
scenes.visual: Weak neurons still fade, but more slowly.
scenes.narration: The losers still die of too little NGF, through Bax. Only the extra push is gone.

scenes.tts: All three predictions held, including the delay.
scenes.visual: All three boxes get ticks.
scenes.narration: All three predictions held, including the delay.

scenes.tts: In the simulations, punishment made the split faster. Without it, weak neurons lingered.
scenes.visual: Two model runs: with punishment, losers fade fast; without, they linger.
scenes.narration: In the simulations, punishment made the split faster. Without it, weak neurons lingered.

scenes.tts: The endpoint is less settled. In the two thousand eight study, the null ganglion reached the normal number by six months.
scenes.caption: The endpoint is less settled. In the 2008 study, the null ganglion reached the normal number by six months.
scenes.visual: The p75-null curve meets the wild-type curve at six months. Label: 2008 study.
scenes.narration: The endpoint is less settled. In the 2008 study, the null ganglion reached the normal number by six months.

scenes.tts: An earlier study from Freda Miller's laboratory also found the loss delayed. But it counted an excess that lasted into adulthood.
scenes.visual: A second dashed p75-null curve stays above wild type into adulthood. Label: earlier study, Miller laboratory.
scenes.narration: An earlier study from Freda Miller's laboratory also found the loss delayed. But it counted an excess that lasted into adulthood.

scenes.tts: So both found the loss delayed. They report different numbers at the latest ages counted.
scenes.visual: Label: both delayed; they differ at the latest ages counted.
scenes.narration: So both found the loss delayed. They report different numbers at the latest ages counted.

scenes.tts: Takeaway. In the proposed model, winners speed the death of losers through p seventy five. Without it, the loss is delayed; whether any neurons are permanently spared is less settled.
scenes.caption: Takeaway. In the proposed model, winners speed the death of losers through p75. Without it, the loss is delayed; whether any neurons are permanently spared is less settled.
scenes.visual: End card: proposed model, punishment through p75 speeds the loss; without it, loss is delayed; the endpoint is less settled.
scenes.narration: Takeaway. In the proposed model, winners speed the death of losers through p75. Without it, the loss is delayed; whether any neurons are permanently spared is less settled.
